goal: Fixed14 toward 641 of 647 external-validation records on its own, with no third-party model and no Phase 2M-F material

amendments.section: recipe design, the control gate reference, and two reporting constraints

power_argument_verified_here.conclusion: a recipe change that fixes 2 or 3 cards cannot be separated from seed noise, so running B and C separately would most likely leave both inconclusive and spend two extra runs to learn nothing

item_1_recipes_B_and_C_are_merged.replaces: the sequential B then C design

with.BC: cosine learning-rate decay to zero over the budget, weight EMA with decay 0.999, and shear augmentation at the archive's declared plus or minus 5 degrees horizontally and vertically

item_1_recipes_B_and_C_are_merged.runs: A and BC, two seeds each
item_1_recipes_B_and_C_are_merged.if_BC_advances: apply item 4, capacity, on top of BC
item_1_recipes_B_and_C_are_merged.ablate_B_against_C: only if BC fails to advance, or later if attribution is needed
item_1_recipes_B_and_C_are_merged.cpu_saved: four runs instead of eight in the item-3 batch

item_2_recipe_D_removed.why: item 0 measured zero-attraction on the control model at 8.3 percent of wrong positions on external validation, against 27.1 percent on frozen v3, and the direction reversed: 2 errors predict zero against 6 errors on a true zero. The precondition the rule set for D is not met.
item_2_recipe_D_removed.if_it_shows_a_prior_driven_gain: report it, and do not reinstate D without a further amendment

item_3_control_gate_reports_both_referen.rule: every candidate reports the 168-control check against both frozen v2 and frozen v3; the cap is applied to the v2 reference as the Phase 2M-C rule defined it, and the v3 figure is reported beside it

item_4_inner_validation_is_never_a_final.why: the 42-sheet label review will correct some inner-validation cards, and only disagreements are reviewed, so absolute accuracy on corrected labels is biased upward
item_4_inner_validation_is_never_a_final.what_is_unaffected: recipe comparisons, because every recipe is scored against the same corrected labels and the bias is shared
item_4_inner_validation_is_never_a_final.forbidden: reporting any inner-validation number as a final accuracy, corrected or original

item_5_the_phase_2m_e_lesson.lesson: two Phase 2M-E findings that looked structural disappeared under longer training. Alignment dominance fell from 15 of 40 wrong records to 4 of 21, and zero-attraction fell from 27.1 percent of wrong positions to 8.3 percent and reversed direction.
item_5_the_phase_2m_e_lesson.conclusion: error anatomy performed on an unconverged model describes the undertraining, not the model. Convergence has to be established before an anatomy is read as a property of the architecture.
item_5_the_phase_2m_e_lesson.consequence_for_this_phase: the ALIGNMENT_DOMINANT token from Phase 2M-E stands as evaluated, and is reported with this qualification attached wherever it is cited

amendments.section: the first review batch is withdrawn; a second design supersedes it

what_went_wrong.finding: in 26 of the 37 sheets the only disagreement between the two candidates was slot 14, and in 28 of 37 slot 14 was among the disagreements
what_went_wrong.why_that_is_a_defect: slot 14 sits about 0.8 digit pitches from the band edge while slot 1 sits about 2.6, because the band context is 0.16 of the line length on the left and 0.04 on the right. The card edge and its shadow fall there. The sheet showed that cell at native scale and asked the owner to adjudicate it.
what_went_wrong.disposition: the 25 verdicts from batch G are not used for any label correction. They were collected against a sheet that did not show what it asked about.

changes: the source crop extends a full band width past the line instead of a third, so the card edge and what lies beyond it are visible
every panel is contrast-stretched on its own percentiles
each disputed digit is shown magnified to 280 px with its slot number named
the disputed positions are bracketed in both candidate strings, which tells the reviewer where to look without revealing which string is the annotation
second_design.unreadable_is_first_class: if the digit still cannot be read, unreadable is the correct answer and is more informative than a guess

a_fourth_instrument_failed.instrument: a per-cell contrast proxy, the 2nd-to-98th percentile dynamic range inside the disputed cell
a_fourth_instrument_failed.what_it_reported: the disputed cells carry HIGHER contrast than the mid-line cells, median ratio 1.19 against 1.10 at slot 1, and none severely degraded
a_fourth_instrument_failed.why_it_is_wrong: dynamic range cannot separate crisp ink on paper from paper lying next to a black void. A half-occluded cell scores as high contrast.
a_fourth_instrument_failed.disposition: not reported as evidence, and no fifth instrument is built. The human verdict is the instrument here, and it is the only one in this project that has not failed a validation.
a_fourth_instrument_failed.running_count: this is the fourth measurement instrument in Phases 2M-E and 2M-G to fail a check after a number had already been computed from it

consequence_if_records_come_back_unreada.meaning: a record whose disputed digit is not present in the image cannot be read correctly by any model, and its label cannot be verified either
consequence_if_records_come_back_unreada.effect_on_the_ceiling: such records lower the attainable train exact further, compounding amendment 10 of the Phase 2M-E rule, which already recorded the 36-record label-error estimate as a lower bound
consequence_if_records_come_back_unreada.effect_on_this_phase: they are excluded from the label-correction ledger and counted separately as an unlabelable floor

amendments.section: verdict parsing extended to three free-text phrases the owner used
amendments.why_this_is_safe: each phrase is an unambiguous synonym of an option already printed on the sheet, which offered A correct, B correct, neither, unreadable and cannot tell. All three map to non-endorsements, so the extension cannot move a single record into or out of the label or prediction counts, and therefore cannot move the label-error rate in either direction. It only moves records out of unparsed and into the unlabelable floor.
amendments.rule_for_the_future: the verdict template will offer the five options as a closed list rather than free text

amendments.section: owner decision: no further human review; a geometric visibility proxy replaces it
amendments.reviewer_budget: exhausted at 111 sheets across four batches; options (a) rebuild-and-re-review and (c) declare futile are rejected

features_per_digit_box_geometry_only: distance from the box to the nearest source-image border, in digit pitches
fraction of the box area lying outside the source image
fraction of the box area landing in band padding, that is the constant 245 fill the warp writes outside the source
whether the band edge clips the box
item_1_visibility_proxy.record_flag: a record is flagged when any of its 14 boxes has (fraction outside the source image + fraction in band padding) at or above theta
item_1_visibility_proxy.theta_selection: leave-one-out cross-validation over the 57 existing training verdicts; the reported sensitivity and specificity are the out-of-fold ones, so theta is never tuned and scored on the same record
item_1_visibility_proxy.calibration_target: unreadable-or-neither against readable, on the 20-sheet and 37-sheet training batches, 57 verdicts in total

usability_threshold_declared_before_comp.rationale: a proxy used to estimate a ceiling must not over-flag, so specificity carries the higher bar; all three are reported with Wilson intervals

item_1_visibility_proxy.if_it_passes: apply it to external validation and report the readable ceiling directly
item_1_visibility_proxy.if_it_fails: report the 37-sheet extrapolation interval as it stands and say plainly that the proxy failed

item_2_source_clipping_versus_band_clipp.distinction: a digit visible in the source image but clipped by our band is a materialization defect of ours, not unreadable data
item_2_source_clipping_versus_band_clipp.report: how many records and digits fall in each category, separately
item_2_source_clipping_versus_band_clipp.propose_a_fix: the right context is 0.04 of the line length against 0.16 on the left; a symmetric or widened right context is the candidate fix, measured but not applied in this phase

item_3_mark_the_2m_e_conclusions_as_inst.why: both came from the sheet design withdrawn in amendment 2, which could not show a clipped digit. With a design that shows it, the same reviewer returned 35 percent unreadable or neither where the old design returned zero.
item_3_mark_the_2m_e_conclusions_as_inst.action: mark them in the Phase 2M-E report; do not re-review

item_4_training_labels.apply: every label correction from every review, including the record from the 20-sheet batch that the control model now reproduces wrongly
item_4_training_labels.exclude_from_training: every record a review judged unreadable or neither
item_4_training_labels.why_exclude: training a model to emit digits for ink that is not in the image teaches it to guess
item_4_training_labels.slot_masking: proxy-based slot masking may be proposed after item 1 validates the proxy, and is not applied in this run

item_5_no_futility_declaration_on_an_ext.forbidden: declaring PHASE2M_G_FUTILE from the extrapolated interval
item_5_no_futility_declaration_on_an_ext.record_instead: 99 percent exact on all records of this archive sits at or above the estimated readable ceiling, interval 636 to 642 of 647, so it is not a well-posed target on this data
report_alongside: accuracy on the records the proxy marks fully visible
an accept/retake curve, exact on accepted at declared coverage levels, for the control model and for every item-3 candidate

amendments.section: item 4 skipped; the A-versus-BC comparison is declared confounded; item 6 is specified in full before BC-final trains

item_4_capacity_skipped.why: BC leaves 8 wrong cards of 241. A capacity change would need 6 concordant wins with zero regressions to reach p below 0.05, out of 8 available. It cannot be established on this sample.

protocol_defect_in_item_3.what_happened: recipes A and BC were both initialized from the control model, and the control model trained on all 2673 external-train records, including the 241 cards later carved out as inner validation. Step 0 of every run reads 237 of 241, which is memorization and not a baseline.
protocol_defect_in_item_3.why_it_confounds_the_comparison: cosine decay to zero and weight EMA at 0.999 both hold the weights nearer their initialization than constant-rate A does, so BC retains more of that memorized inner-validation content by construction
protocol_defect_in_item_3.consequence: the inner-validation difference, 233.5 for BC against 229.5 for A, is confounded with how fast each recipe forgets its initialization. It is evidence neither for nor against BC as a recipe.
protocol_defect_in_item_3.quantification: the weight distance from initialization is reported per checkpoint for both recipes
protocol_defect_in_item_3.what_a_clean_comparison_would_need: restarting both recipes from frozen v2, which never saw external data
protocol_defect_in_item_3.effect_on_the_advancement_decision: BC still satisfies the declared advancement rule, improving in both seeds, and is carried into item 6 on that basis. The report must state that the rule was satisfied on a confounded metric.

item_6_step_count_amended.why_that_fails: the inner-validation curves decline monotonically from step 0 because the initialization had memorized those cards, so their best step is step 0, which is not a training budget
item_6_step_count_amended.source: the Phase 2M-E control run budget, the same figure item 3 used

item_6_declared_before_training.recipe: BC: cosine decay to zero over 2664 steps, weight EMA 0.999, shear plus or minus 5 degrees
item_6_declared_before_training.training_pool: the full external train minus the 13 excluded unreadable records, plus the internal replay pool, with the corrected labels
item_6_declared_before_training.why_3101: the lower seed, following the Phase 2M-C convention. The inner-validation result is confounded, so it is not used to choose the seed.

four_phase_tta.why: the item 1 probe showed a consistent gain with zero regressions in both cross-fitted halves but did not reach significance. Keeping the primary reading single-view makes it directly comparable with the control model reading, which was single-view.

two_seed_ensemble.status: secondary only, never the primary candidate

item_6_declared_before_training.checkpoint_policy: the final checkpoint is used. No checkpoint is selected on any metric.

item_6_the_comparison_that_counts.against: the control model's existing external-validation reading, 626 records and 276 cards
item_6_the_comparison_that_counts.not_against: recipe A, whose comparison with BC is confounded as recorded above
item_6_the_comparison_that_counts.test: paired card-level two-sided sign test on discordant cards
item_6_the_comparison_that_counts.why_it_is_clean: neither the control model nor BC-final trained on external validation

item_5_reporting_with_a_failed_proxy.proxy_status: FAILED its declared bar: out-of-fold sensitivity 1.000, specificity 0.000, balanced accuracy 0.500, against the required 0.60, 0.70 and 0.70
item_5_reporting_with_a_failed_proxy.consequence: accuracy on records the proxy marks fully visible cannot be reported, because the proxy does not identify them
item_5_reporting_with_a_failed_proxy.substitute_permitted: accuracy on records whose geometric flag score is exactly zero may be reported as a descriptive split, explicitly labelled as not a validated visibility measure
still_required_for_both_models: the accept/retake curve at the declared coverage levels

amendments.section: coverage levels for the accept/retake curve, and the freeze
amendments.ranking_statistic: per record, the minimum over the 14 slots of top-1 probability minus top-2, the same statistic Phase 2M-E used
amendments.status: external validation, exploratory; no operating point is frozen

freeze.no_switching_after_reading: the control model and BC-final are statistically indistinguishable on external validation, 4 wins against 2 losses at p = 0.6875. The candidate was declared before the read and does not change because the result came back flat.
freeze.primary_reading_is_single_view: the four-phase TTA line stays secondary, as amendment 5 declared, even though it scored highest

amendments.proxy_status_restated: the geometric visibility proxy was built and reported: it FAILED its declared bar with out-of-fold sensitivity 1.000, specificity 0.000 and balanced accuracy 0.500 against the required 0.60/0.70/0.70. Accuracy on proxy-fully-visible records therefore cannot be reported. The permitted substitute, accuracy on records whose geometric flag score is exactly zero, is reported and labelled as not a validated visibility measure.

starting_point.glyph_ceiling: the 30-cell blinded review returned 26 of 28 backing the annotation and zero unreadable, so the glyph ceiling is in the model and not in the images
starting_point.memorization_observed: 1 of the 4 known label-error training records now reproduces the wrong label

governance.hash_checks: fixed14_v3_shadow.verify_shadow_candidates at entry and at exit, as in 2M-D
governance.access: the Phase 2M-E Access class: external train and external validation only; the external test is refused at every level and the locked audit is never opened
governance.privacy: no national ID is printed to any file, any log or any chat output, ever

evaluation_protocol.external_validation_is_spent: 647 records. From this phase onward it is read once per final candidate as confirmation only, and never to choose anything

inner_validation.stratified_by: Roboflow origin: multi-copy train-folder cards against single originals
inner_validation.identity_isolation: no identity group may appear in both inner train and inner validation, and the split is deterministic for the seed
inner_validation.unit_of_decision: card exact (all copies), with a paired two-sided sign test on discordant cards

cap.reference: frozen v2, as in the Phase 2M-C rule

internal_controls.rule: any candidate that breaches the cap is rejected regardless of any external gain

evaluation_protocol.reporting: records, cards (all copies) and end-to-end everywhere, each with a cluster bootstrap CI by identity group, 2000 reps, seed 20260921

instrumentation.memorization_monitor: at every evaluation, log the model's prediction on each of the 4 known label-error training records and each of the 15 verified-correct-label records from the Phase 2M-E blinded review, so memorization is visible as it happens
instrumentation.monitor_reading: any of the 4 flipping to reproduce its wrong label is memorization and is reported whatever the aggregate does; the two counts are never netted

item_0_rebaseline.on: the control model, before anything else
measures: record-level family anatomy on external train and on external validation
zero-attraction: errors predicting 0 against errors on true 0, and the share of wrong positions predicting 0, which was 27.1 percent on v3
item_0_rebaseline.gate: if the control model breaches the control cap, report it and stop before item 3

item_1_zero_training_probes.why_cross_fit: external validation is the only set the control model has not trained on, so a probe tuned and read on the same records would be selection, not measurement

cross_fit.procedure: choose on half A, read on half B, then swap; report both halves

probe_a_phase_tta.units: pixels of horizontal translation, cv2.warpAffine with BORDER_REPLICATE
probe_a_phase_tta.why_these: the stride is 4, so 0 to 3 covers every sub-stride sampling phase exactly once; Phase 2M-E showed the gain follows sampling phase and not direction
probe_a_phase_tta.combination: arithmetic mean of the four softmax outputs

probe_b_logit_adjustment.form: logits[k, c] minus tau times log p_k(c), where p_k(c) is the training frequency of class c at slot k
probe_b_logit_adjustment.caveat_to_state_in_the_report: logit adjustment targets balanced error, while the metric here is plain exact match on the same distribution the priors come from, so it may well hurt. This probe decides the question; a gain is not presumed.

item_1_zero_training_probes.reporting: card-level paired results for each half, never pooled into one number

item_2_label_cleaning.sheets: the training records the control model still gets wrong, same blinded design as the Phase 2M-E batches
item_2_label_cleaning.plus: the 4 label errors already identified in the 20-sheet review
item_2_label_cleaning.ledger: artifacts/phase2m_g/label_corrections.json; the original label files are never edited

validation_labels.if_corrected_labels_are_also_reported: state that only disagreements were reviewed, which biases the corrected number upward and makes it not comparable with any earlier figure

item_3_recipes.step_budget_source: the same budget as the Phase 2M-E control run
item_3_recipes.training_pool: external train minus inner validation, plus the internal replay pool, with the Phase 2M-C batch mix
item_3_recipes.labels: the corrected training labels from item 2

recipes.A: the control recipe retrained on train minus inner validation; the reference
recipes.B: A plus cosine learning-rate decay to zero over the budget and weight EMA with decay 0.999
recipes.C: B plus shear augmentation. The current Phase 2M-C augmentation has no shear at all; the archive README declares plus or minus 5 degrees horizontally and vertically, and shear was the only monotone distortion in Phase 2M-E at 3.3 times across its quartiles.
recipes.D: the better of B and C plus class reweighting, only if item 0 still shows zero-attraction and item 1b showed it is prior-driven

item_3_recipes.order: sequential: A and B first, then C, then D, each on top of the current best
item_3_recipes.advancement: a recipe advances only if it improves inner-validation card exact in both seeds and passes the control cap

item_4_capacity.precondition: glyph_only is still at least half of the remaining inner-validation errors after item 3
item_4_capacity.step_1: widen the classification head, currently pooled 128 to Dense 96 to Dense 10
item_4_capacity.step_2: if still needed, widen the encoder channels

item_5_futility.compute: the upper bound on external-validation records if every remaining error in the families the unused levers can still touch were fixed
item_5_futility.rule: if that bound is below 641, report that 99 percent on this set is out of reach for the remaining plan and stop

item_6_final_candidate.retrain_on: the full external train plus replay
item_6_final_candidate.step_count: fixed from inner validation, not re-tuned

two_seed_ensemble.condition: a probability-mean ensemble of the two seeds may be the final candidate only if it beats the better single seed on inner-validation card exact with a paired two-sided sign test at p below 0.05

item_6_final_candidate.label_on_the_external_validation_number: EXPLORATORY: it was used for selection in Phase 2M-C and analysed in Phase 2M-E

item_7_no_held_out_claim.forbidden: any claim of a held-out 99 percent
what_a_claimable_number_would_need: a hidden test set supplied by the supervisor
item_7_no_held_out_claim.whose_decision: the owner's; this phase does not act on it

frozen_state_hashes.checked: at entry and again at exit
